formula: Frozen RGB logit + bounded shared-function cue/reference contrast. Zero residual exactly preserves the fitted RGB scorer, including at inference.
matched_RGB_control: Same frozen RGB base,26+17 inputs, parameter count, fixed RGB cue marker, data regimes, row draws, loss, optimizer and seeds; replace the auxiliary view with the existing ordinary second RGB view

unavailable_motion: For appearance-only links: zero ownership/flow counts, zero unknown spatial IoU/centre displacement and motion-dependent quality channels, retain actual box-shape ratios, RGB/cue descriptors and crop contrast; temporal feature saturates at8 frames.
